_note: Spring B L10 Scorecard v1 — the 15 always-on measurables as agreed (see spring-b-l10-scorecard mockup). Owners, goals, and weekly history are intentionally blank: EOS wants one named person and one number per line, assigned by the team over time via the scorecard's own Settings. Goal 0 = track-only (no scoreable target yet). The four not-yet-defined lines carry the open question as a note. No resolver_key — every line is manual for v1 (nothing auto-sourced). Slots, the coverage matrix, the four derived rates, and the parked list are deliberately out of v1.

metrics.name: Content Assets Shipped vs. Planned
metrics.note: Weekly count shipped against planned (x of y); the plan becomes the goal once set.

metrics.name: Mighty Network Growth
metrics.note: To settle: the unit — net new members or % growth; platform or community (WhatsApp/GHL-only members aren't visible to a Mighty Networks count).

metrics.name: Engagement
metrics.note: To settle: the definition — weekly active %, call attendance, or posts + comments. Can't carry a goal until this is decided.

metrics.name: Members at Risk
metrics.note: To settle: the trigger — at risk after how many missed calls.

metrics.name: Agents at 0
metrics.note: To settle: the window — zero production over 30 / 60 / 90 days (60 is common: it survives one slow month without flagging everyone).
